description: This file defines the GoteoCore class implementing ExtensionInterface, providing utility functions for session, request, user, configuration, and role management within the Goteo application framework.

classes.name: GoteoCore
classes.description: Implements ExtensionInterface, providing utility methods for session, request, user, configuration, and role management within Goteo.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the static request object, creating it if not set.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array of filters.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of callable functions for templates.

methods.name: is_ajax
methods.description: Checks if request is an XMLHttpRequest.

methods.name: is_pronto
methods.description: Checks if request is a 'pronto' AJAX request, considering debug mode.

methods.name: has_query
methods.description: Checks if a GET parameter exists.

methods.name: has_post
methods.description: Checks if a POST parameter exists.

methods.name: get_main_url
methods.description: Returns main URL, optionally for a language.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Returns URL, optionally for a language.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Returns current user object if available.

methods.name: get_user_location
methods.description: Returns user location, creating by IP if user not logged in.

methods.name: has_role
methods.description: Checks if user has a specific role in a node.

methods.name: is_module_admin
methods.description: Checks if user is admin of a specific module.

methods.name: is_logged
methods.description: Checks if user is logged in.

methods.name: is_master_node
methods.description: Checks if current node is master.
